settings.label: Save versions
settings.description: Save a version after this long without a change in the vault. Manual saves only on request, when the window closes and around agent turns.

settings.label: Sync
settings.description: How often to fetch and push. Needs a remote (not available yet).

settings.label: Agent turns
settings.description: Each agent turn gets its own version. Off: agent edits join yours.

settings.label: Large files (LFS)
settings.description: Track large files with Git LFS. Not available yet.

settings.label: LFS threshold (MB)
settings.description: Files above this size are tracked with LFS.
